{{Quote|Too many questions, Aryn. I've got engspice aboard. They'll seize the ship and arrest us both. We have to go. Now.|Zeerid Korr, to Aryn Leneer, during the skirmish|<ref name="The Old Republic: Deceived" />}}
A '''skirmish''' was fought in the [[Yinta Lake spaceport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vulta]] in [[3653 BBY]], near the end of the [[Great Galactic War]]. Attempting to protect some [[engspice]] that he had to [[Transport/Legends|transport]] to the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Zeerid Korr]] partnered with rogue [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Aryn Leneer]] to defend his cargo from a team of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] led by the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Vrath Xizor]], who tried to steal the engspice for the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]]. A short skirmish ensued that ended with Korr and Leneer escaping with the [[Spice/Legends|spice]]. Xizor subsequently looked for another way to pilfer the engspice from Korr.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|I just want the cargo.|Vrath Xizor|<ref name="The Old Republic: Deceived" />}}
In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3653 BBY]],<ref name="TEA" /> near the end of the [[Great Galactic War]], the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Zeerid Korr]] was tasked with delivering a load of [[engspice]] to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], for the [[Exchange]] criminal organization. The rogue [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Aryn Leneer]] accompanied Korr on his [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the ''[[Fatman]]'', for [[Transport/Legends|transportation]] to the currently [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith]]-[[Sacking of Coruscant|held]] Coruscant, where she hoped to avenge the [[Death/Legends|death]] of her [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]], [[Ven Zallow]], who had fallen at the hands of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Empire. [[Vrath Xizor]], a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] hired by the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]], set out with a team of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]]&mdash;including [[Deron]], [[Keene]], and [[Lom (mercenary)|Lom]]&mdash;to stop Korr so that the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] could exclusively market engspice. Xizor followed Korr and Leneer to the [[Yinta Lake spaceport]], near the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Yinta Lake]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vulta]], where the smuggler and the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Knight stopped on their journey to Coruscant. There, Xizor and his men attempted to steal their cargo.<ref name="The Old Republic: Deceived" />

==The skirmish==
{{Quote|Everybody down!|Vrath Xizor, to some civilian bystanders|<ref name="The Old Republic: Deceived" />}}
After Xizor shouted for everyone in the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] to drop to the ground, he and his team fell under fire from Korr, who ran for cover as he loosed [[Laser/Legends|laser]] blasts at his attackers. Leneer, meanwhile, protected herself by [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|wielding]] her [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] in a defensive pattern. As the [[Lightfight|firefight]] continued, two of Xizor's men were shot and killed, Korr was slightly wounded, and several civilians in the spaceport were injured. Korr and Leneer eventually made a dash for the [[Hangar/Legends|landing pad]] where the ''Fatman'' was docked. Xizor's group continued to fire at them, however, and Leneer received a shot to the calf. Korr and Leneer finally reached the ''Fatman'' and boarded the ship, shooting at a few more of Xizor's men along the way.<ref name="The Old Republic: Deceived" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|I'm going to fly right up to an Imperial cruiser.|Vrath Xizor, discussing his plans|<ref name="The Old Republic: Deceived" />}}
Although suffering from minor injuries, Korr and Leneer escaped with the engspice aboard the ''Fatman''. They finally made it to Coruscant, where Leneer [[Duel in the ruins of the Jedi Temple|dueled]] with [[Darth Malgus]], a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] who had led the assault on the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] and was responsible for Zallow's death. Meanwhile, Xizor and his remaining men left the spaceport and began planning a new way to steal the engspice from Korr. To gather more resources to complete their objective, Xizor's team decided to temporarily join forces with the Sith Empire.<ref name="The Old Republic: Deceived" />

==Behind the scenes==
The skirmish in the Yinta Lake spaceport appeared in the novel ''[[The Old Republic: Deceived]]'', written by [[Paul S. Kemp]] and published in [[2011]].<ref name="The Old Republic: Deceived" />
